page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 128 physical cores with a single thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. To support high-throughput data transfers and network-bound operations, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The dedicated core allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-memory ratio make this instance highly cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is designed for parallel processing tasks, high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving at scale, and CPU-bound application servers.
